race.comment: HELLO G'DAY (11) is the main danger after just missing the bob at Taree, with the debut fourth at Wyong giving the profile added substance. Peaking now and can get the job done. BABY CAN CAN (4) is another debutant with local trial grounding and could sneak a minor spot at a big quote if she handles raceday pressure. MOROSINI (13) was among the placings last time when third at this track and will be fitter again. Each-way chance. ROY KELTON (3) resumes after four months with two late-closing fourths behind him to end last campaign. Can kick off on the right note here. FIRST ASSAULT (1) is back from a five-month break. Could run into the minor money fresh.
